title: D2 pagination error codes spec
description: Domain-specialized copy of contracts/error-codes/error-codes.canonical.schema.json, narrowed to the portable pagination catalog: the LIB_PAGINATION_* code-prefix regex (owner LIB, domain token PAGINATION), the [400, 500] httpStatus subset, and the two categories those statuses carry. Conforms to the canonical 7-field set (including factoryShape) but tightens the value constraints so editors catch a non-LIB_PAGINATION_ code, a non-400/500 status, or an out-of-set category at edit time. This is the source-of-truth catalog that DcsvIo.D2.Pagination.ErrorCodes.SourceGen reads to emit PaginationErrorCodes.g.cs + PaginationFailures.g.cs into DcsvIo.D2.Pagination.

code.description: Wire-format error code (SCREAMING_SNAKE, LIB_PAGINATION_*-prefixed - owner LIB, domain PAGINATION). Must be unique across the spec.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status mapping. 400 describes something the caller sent and is fixed by a different request; 500 describes a host configuration or encode defect the caller can do nothing about. In the unified generator the status selects the base D2Result delegation factory (400 -> ValidationFailed; 500 -> UnhandledException).

category.description: Closed semantic/telemetry classification. NOT the factory selector - httpStatus drives factory selection. Added to the wire (gRPC trailers + JSON envelope) so consumers can do generic class-based handling without importing the producer's catalog.

userMessageKey.description: Translation key reference rendered as the messages argument on the emitted D2Result factory (e.g. TK.Common.Pagination.CURSOR_INVALID). The generator enforces existence by inverse-transforming the symbol path to the snake_case key (TK.Common.Pagination.CURSOR_INVALID -> common_pagination_CURSOR_INVALID) and asserting it is present in contracts/messages/en-US.json (D2ERC002). One key per code, because a caller shown a paging failure needs to know which request parameter to change.

factoryName.description: PascalCase symbol for the emitted factory method. It is the code with its LIB_PAGINATION_ prefix removed, rendered in Pascal case (LIB_PAGINATION_CURSOR_SORT_MISMATCH -> CursorSortMismatch). Must be unique across the spec.

factoryShape.description: Closed enum that drives the generated factory's signature variant. standard: the one universal error-factory shape (messages?, inputErrors?, errorCode?, category?, traceId?) - ALL optional; the errorCode / category overrides are how a delegating domain factory stamps a specific code + category on its base status. none: no factory generated for this code. Every pagination entry is standard.

doc.description: XML <summary> text rendered on the emitted constant + factory.

deprecated.description: When true, the entry is deprecated: the generated C# constant + factory carry [Obsolete] and the TS constant + factory carry @deprecated. Additive - the entry is NEVER deleted. Deleting a deprecated (or non-deprecated) entry is a breaking change the JSON-diff gate fails.

deprecatedReason.description: Plain dev-facing English explaining why the code is deprecated; rendered into the [Obsolete("...")] message, the @deprecated JSDoc, and the changelog entry. NOT a TK key (developer-facing, not user-facing).

replacedBy.description: Wire code of the successor entry (e.g. RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND). Must reference a real, non-deprecated entry in the merged registry. Omit for pure retirement with no replacement.

sunset.description: ISO-8601 date for the RFC 8594 Sunset response header. A host whose response pipeline emits that header reads the date from here; a host that does not ignores it.
